entries.7a1e65c673b22c8a: The medium-term management plan 'Hiday Challenge' was formulated in April 2025 and is being pursued on a rolling basis, reviewed every year to respond quickly to changes in the business environment. Key priorities are store strategy, including expanding stores in northern Kanto and accelerating openings in unopened areas and along roadsides; expanding domestic share and entering overseas markets through the FC business; considering alliances and M&A; strengthening recruitment and personnel development; reducing labor and improving store operating efficiency through DX; developing new products and expanding sales channels; strengthening branding; and promoting sustainability initiatives. The company aims to contribute to regional revitalization as social infrastructure through expanding its store network.
